title: Jubilant Mexican Beans Quesadilla
description: A show-off Mexican dish featuring refried beans and ferment-jang, with a floral twist and cheese-pull, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This gluten-free-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
In a bowl, mix together refried beans, ferment-jang, and a pinch of salt.
Add diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they are softened.
In a separate pan, warm the gluten-free tortillas over low heat.
Spoon about 1/4 cup of the bean mixture onto half of each tortilla.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the bean mixture.
Fold the tortillas in half to enclose the filling.
Cook the quesadillas in the skillet for about 2-3 minutes on each side, until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crispy.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and garnish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
